description: Verse translates text between 100 languages (Meta's many-to-many model on Workers AI, MyMemory as the fallback). One call, one translation of up to the route's character limit. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/translate.
name: paid_translate
title: Translate text (0.05 USDC, x402)
